gems.description: Browse the Gem candidates related to your keyword, the most underrated ones first.

gems.empty: No Gem candidate matched this keyword. This list only covers a limited pool built from the most depended-upon packages of 12 package registries, so a repository that is missing here is not rated any lower.
gems.unmatchableQuery: We could not take any term out of this keyword to narrow the list. Matching runs as whole-word matches against package names and repository names, which are alphanumeric identifiers, so a keyword without alphanumeric words cannot narrow the list. Trying an English keyword such as "image processing" may surface related Gem candidates.
gems.relaxedNotice: No candidate contained all of your words, so the list is narrowed by "{token}" only.
gems.attribution: About this data: dependent package counts and star counts come from {source} ({license}) open data and are reference values, so they can differ from the latest values on GitHub and from the detail page. The order (Gem Index) is recomputed here.
